title: [Dev] NSv1/v3 - All treatments doesn't sync between AAPS and AAPSClient when using bolus calc AND Virtual pump (dash)
symptom: When entering bolus calc in AAPS, it doesn't sync over to AAPSClient in all cases. The missed treatment sync caused incorrect IOB/COB in AAPSClient. The treatments were not in Nightscout, so AAPSClient can likely be excluded from the issue.
cause: Nightscout doesn't support v3 protocol internally. That's the reason why you cannot add entries though NS UI, it doesn't handle remove entries etc (while AAPS is using v3 protocol).
evidence_quote: Nightscout doesn't support v3 protocol internaly. That's the reason why you cannot add entries though NS UI, it doesn't handle remove entries etc (while AAPS is using v3 protocol)
